# Screenshot Planning — Git-Aware Dev Journal

## Screenshots

### 1. Add Journal Entry Dialog
- **Title:** "Quick Entry with Ctrl+Shift+J"
- **What to capture:** The journal entry dialog showing the entry type dropdown, text field, and the auto-populated git context (commit, branch, file).

### 2. Timeline View
- **Title:** "Browse Your Development Story"
- **What to capture:** The Dev Journal tool window showing the timeline with entries of different types (Notes, Decisions, TODOs) with icons, timestamps, and branch labels.

### 3. Code Hover Context
- **Title:** "Why Did I Write This Code?"
- **What to capture:** Mouse hovering over a line of code showing the journal entry tooltip explaining the reasoning behind the code.

### 4. Branch Narrative
- **Title:** "Auto-Generated Branch Story"
- **What to capture:** The branch narrative view showing the automatically assembled timeline of work done on a feature branch.

### 5. Auto-Captured Conventional Commits
- **Title:** "Commits Become Journal Entries"
- **What to capture:** The timeline showing entries auto-created from conventional commits (feat:, fix:, refactor:) with their original messages.

### 6. Blame View Integration
- **Title:** "Journal Notes in Git Blame"
- **What to capture:** The git blame view with the extra journal note column showing associated entries next to code lines.

### 7. Standup Generator (Pro)
- **Title:** "One-Click Standup Reports"
- **What to capture:** The generated standup report in Markdown format showing yesterday's work, today's plan, and blockers.

### 8. Entry Type Filtering
- **Title:** "Filter by Entry Type"
- **What to capture:** The timeline view with filters active, showing only Decision entries or only Blocker entries.

---

## Video Demo Outline (55 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Plugin name and tagline with IDE in background |
| 5-15s | Add entry | Press Ctrl+Shift+J, fill in a Decision entry, show git context auto-populated |
| 15-25s | Timeline | Open the Dev Journal tool window, browse entries with different types |
| 25-35s | Code context | Hover over code to see the journal entry explaining why it was written |
| 35-45s | Branch narrative | Switch to branch narrative view showing the auto-generated story |
| 45-55s | CTA | Show standup generator (Pro) and "Install from JetBrains Marketplace" |
